scientific_integrity: General minimax effective-resistance formulation predates this result and is credited to Ghosh–Boyd–Saberi. No claim of external validation or verified novelty beyond examined material.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite spider-tree topology, strictly positive real prices and power exponent; exact theorem established by analytical proof. Not a result for arbitrary trees or additional edges. Comparison with unindexed general tree-upgrading literature may be incomplete.
title: The one-exception law for resistance-diameter-optimal spider trees under power-law conductance costs
